lede: Louisiana carries the stronger underlying team rating — -4.6 against -10.5, a 5.9-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Charlotte +6.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Louisiana winning 66% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 79% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
